The fourteenth beta of **HAUNTED.EXE**, a Halloween screensaver for Windows in real VGA modes: a possessed 486 PC (HAUNT.EXE) and a Wolfenstein-style crypt crawl (CATACOMB) that you can take over and play by holding **H**, or any button on a game controller, for three seconds.

The dead have been drawn again, they have learnt to think, and every screen is now cut in stone.

### Before you upgrade

**Coming from the thirteenth beta:** your saves carry over. Going back is another matter: the thirteenth can't read a piece that has rolled one of this beta's two new stats (Sprint and Physic), and drops it, and it forgets the steps bought in their two new lines of points. If you might go back, keep a copy first, from a command prompt:

```
reg export HKCU\Software\HalloweenVGASaver haunted-backup.reg
```

Double-clicking `haunted-backup.reg` puts it back. Your settings carry over either way.

**Coming from the twelfth or earlier:** as the thirteenth's notes say. The eleventh beta changed saves one way, and this one keeps that change: keep a copy first, as above.

### New in this beta

**The dead, drawn again.**

- **Every creature redrawn by hand, face first.** Skulls and faces are pixelled one at a time, and every skull in the game is the same skull: the skeleton's, the shield-bearer's, the wall skull's, the knight's under his helm, the deacon's in his hood. Each creature has been re-proportioned, and each has a side view for walking across your line. The Drowned, the imps and the gargoyles are new from the ground up.
- **Eyes that show from anywhere.** Every creature that has eyes keeps them bright in any light and the thickest fog. The shade alone still shows only in light, eyes and all.
- **Rank beyond colour.** A rank still colours the body, and now it marks it as well: rags and mould at II, frost and a notch at III, old blood and an arrow at IV, char, an iron crown and a shackle at V, and gold leaf and a death-mask on the gilded. From rank III a spirit's vapour rises off them.
- **Three bosses redrawn.** The Ill-Fated Knight is now a fallen paladin in a crown of iron spikes. The Wandering Spider is an old grizzled matriarch with a skull on her back. The Black Deacon is a profane bishop twice a deacon's size, with a mitre, a crozier and a censer.
- **The caster's hand moves**, idling while it is up and drawing in, clawing and flinging open as it casts.
- **Every prop and pickup of the Crypts and the Catacombs remade:** bones and skull piles, candles and chandeliers, headstones and crosses, chains and gibbets, pillars, coins, chalices, crowns and chests.

**The dead, thinking.**

- **They see and hear, and they forget.** Sight has a facing now. In the dark the living see less, and one caught unaware takes half again and staggers. They hear footsteps, spells, doors and deaths along the halls, not through the walls. They grow wary and go to look, hunt you, track you to where you were, search, and give up, so you can lose them.
- **Calm, they keep posts, walk rounds and roam.**
- **Packs.** The Order's file, shields first and throwers behind; hounds in twos to fours; bats asleep on a dim room's ceiling; the buried rising one after another. A pack calls when one sees you, and all of it comes. Its fighters take turns, and only so many fight you at once. Fell the leader, or half of it, and the pack breaks.
- **Callers and scavengers.** The wall skull screams as it wakes, the gargoyle shrieks, the deacon calls, the roost cries, and whatever hears goes to look. Ghouls hear a death from far off and come to feed.
- **Hunters.** You leave a trail that goes cold in two minutes and is lost in water. On some levels a band waits at the far end and is let loose after a while: the watch goes to your last loud noise, and hounds and spiders follow your trail. The shade stalks you from behind and strikes when you stand still.
- **Ambushes**, from level 7: a kill room with its teeth along the wall either side of the door, a bait that shows itself and backs away towards it, and signs outside for the careful. A stinger and *AN AMBUSH* the first time each run.
- **Cunning by rank.** The higher the rank, the more it knows. A green creature falls back to its pack when hurt, and throwers duck behind corners. Blue ones step aside from slow spells and wait beside a doorway you hold. Red packs come round another way, and spread out when you have a splash in hand. Black ones feint and read a charge. Throwers lob over a corner to where they last saw you. From the Deep on, hazards hurt the dead too.
- **New mixes as you go down**, about one every two levels: the watch and its dead, the nest, the knight and his hounds, the deacon's congregation, the brood's guard, sentinels that wake each other, bands of two kinds and three, and what you passed by gathering at the exit.
- **Three new kinds.**
  - **The Whipper-In** (from level 22), the Order's huntsman with his horn, his whip and his hounds. Fell him and they run wild.
  - **The Sexton** (from 26), who rings his handbell at each turn of his round, and hard when he sees you. Kill him with the bell raised, catch him unaware or freeze him, and it isn't rung.
  - **The Lightless** (from 32), black glass with no eyes, which feels your light instead, and puts out wisps.
- **Doors sound like their run.**

**The caster.**

- **A sprint.** Hold Shift to run forward at half again your pace while a slim meter lasts. On a controller, press the left stick; any other button can be chosen from Esc's question or the settings. The meter fills sooner the more health you have past 200. Sprinting is louder than walking. **Sprint** is a new stat on boots, with a line in the points.
- **Physic**, a new stat on robes and amulets with a line of its own, multiplies what a potion restores, up to five times.
- **The Lantern of the Dead** is shuttered or lit by holding L; a tap still opens the wisps' list.
- **Places to mend**, one a level (two from the Hollows), set in a room's wall. Press E facing one and keep still, and your health comes back to three quarters, or all of it with Physic at its cap. It is heard far off, so the dead may come to see.

**The screens, cut in stone.**

- **Every menu, card and the tally in weathered marble**, in faces of our own at the same sizes, keeping their colours, with the crypt dimmed round the edge. The same words, the same keys.
- **The Alignment is a skill tree.** Each node is a socket with an icon in its line's colour, its grooves filling as you buy, and a pane beside it says what the chosen node does and what it waits for.
- **The wardrobe** shows the seven worn places on a carved figure. **The bestiary** stands each creature in an arched niche. Esc's question and every card are headstones, and the tally is a memorial tablet.
- **The status bar and every word over the crypt** are in the run's own stone, in place of black boxes.
- **Mended on the screens.** Ascend's rows no longer lie over one another. The Portal's list scrolls, so its words no longer go missing. The tally's notes and a stone's page no longer run into their figures. The controls card and the pop-ups no longer cover her wares, death's card or a menu.

**On the page**, *Then and now*: the same moments in the first beta, the thirteenth and this one, side by side. Click any of them to see it large.

The screensaver's caster finds it harder, as it should: from level 1 it dies about a tenth more often in 100 minutes, on the ordinary levels most of all, and reaches about as far (nine levels) as before. From deeper starts it reaches as far as before without dying. The knight is still its wall.

This is still a beta. Everything new has been tested only in the harness, which draws exactly what the game draws. None of it has been played by hand or run on Windows or under Wine, and the new art and screens haven't been seen on a real screen. The Windows build is compiled and smoke-tested by GitHub Actions. If something goes wrong on your machine, please [open an issue](https://github.com/ASPDesignLabs/HAUNTED.EXE/issues) with your Windows version and graphics card.

### Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `HAUNTED.EXE` | The program on its own. Double-click it to open it in a window: hold H, or a controller's button, to play, F11 for full screen, Esc to quit. |
| `HAUNTED.scr` | The same program as a screensaver. Right-click it and choose **Install**, then pick HAUNTED.EXE in Screen Saver Settings. |
| `HAUNTED-<version>-win64.zip` | Both, with `install.cmd`, `uninstall.cmd`, `capture.cmd` for recording, the README, previews and the full source. |
| `HAUNTED-<version>-web.zip` | The same game built for the browser, the page that plays it, to serve yourself. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of the files above. |

The files aren't code-signed, so SmartScreen may stop them the first time: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*.

The project page: https://aspdesignlabs.github.io/HAUNTED.EXE/

Play it in the browser, with nothing to download: https://aspdesignlabs.github.io/HAUNTED.EXE/play/ (Space casts there, since Ctrl is the browser's; the ledger is kept in the browser).
